findings.title: Error event data is paired with the wrong error IDs when nodestore omits missing events
findings.body: `fetch_error_details` zips `error_ids` with `events.values()`. If any requested node is missing from nodestore, `get_multi` omits it, so subsequent values shift and are paired with the wrong error IDs. This can attach an error's title/message/timestamp to a different error ID in the generated summary request. Look up each event by the generated node ID instead, or zip against the node IDs/keys so missing entries preserve position.

findings.title: Feature-flagged dashboard table path renders empty data and ignores query results
findings.body: When `organization.features.includes('use-table-widget-visualization')` is true, this branch always renders `<TableWidgetVisualization columns={[]} tableData={{ data: [], meta: { fields: {}, units: {} } }} />` instead of passing the actual `result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`, and field aliases. Any organization with this flag enabled will see blank table widgets, losing dashboard data. The feature branch should use the actual table results or remain disabled until implemented.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion validation for age/timestamp uses truthiness, so zero values bypass it
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` checks `if self.initial_data.get("age")`, and `validate_age` checks `if self.initial_data.get("timestamp")`. Because `0` is falsy, a report with both `age=0` and `timestamp=0` is not rejected even though the field contract says age and timestamp must be mutually exclusive. Use an explicit presence check such as `if "age" in self.initial_data` / `if "timestamp" in self.initial_data` (or `is not None`).

findings.title: Span samples analytics sends `Visualize` class instances while other effects send serialized objects
findings.body: In the `queryType === 'samples'` effect, `trackAnalytics` is called with `visualizes: visualizes` instead of `visualizes.map(visualize => visualize.toJSON())`. The aggregate and traces effects in the same file serialize these objects before sending. Passing class instances can send non-plain objects or private fields to analytics instead of the expected `BaseVisualize` JSON shape, producing inconsistent or unusable analytics data for span samples.
